What Happens in Chainsaw Man Manga Chapter 2 (Summary)

Makima takes Denji to a train and feeds him for the first time in what feels like forever. Denji eats hungrily while Makima explains the world of Public Safety Devil Hunters — government agents who kill devils in exchange for pay. She tells him he will be working under her as a devil hunter, and that as long as he is useful to her he will be kept alive and treated well. Denji, overwhelmed by the simple act of being fed and cared for, develops an immediate and intense attachment to Makima.

On the train Makima asks Denji what his dream is. He says it is to live a normal life — good food, a girlfriend, maybe a morning with toast and jam. It is the same dream he told Pochita in the previous chapter, and the repetition makes clear how little Denji has ever asked for. Makima listens without mocking him, which is already more than anyone else has ever offered him. The chapter shows Denji processing the fact that Pochita is now inside his heart, and he quietly mourns the loss of his only companion while also carrying him forward.

They arrive in Tokyo and Makima brings Denji to the Public Safety offices. She introduces him to her superior and explains his situation — Denji is a devil hybrid, a rare and dangerous type, but one she believes can be controlled and used. She formally registers him as a devil hunter under her supervision. Denji is given a place to stay and a meal, and the chapter ends with him lying down for the first time in a real bed, completely overwhelmed by how much his life has changed in a single day.

Tatsuki
